identityContract.assignedCodes: Each row has a checked-in immutable UUID URN. Runtime seeders must read literal codes from this manifest; never derive identity from mutable display text, generated IDs, or collection order.
identityContract.sourceKeys: Exact source declaration keys are reconciliation references. Any source-key change requires explicit review while retaining the assigned seedCode.
identityContract.sourceIds: Explicit legacy IDs and stable codes are recorded verbatim and must be preserved. The 287 rows whose current source IDs are produced by id++ now record the exact current generated sourceId within each seeder method; no new-ID mapping exception is taken.

exerciseCatalogReconciliation.rule: The 20 name matches are represented once each, with the prior starter code and ENGINE_<planning source ID> replacement both recorded. The 40 unmatched planning definitions create catalog rows; the other 44 starter rows remain.

knownAmbiguities: FoodItem and Exercise have no stable source catalog code; explicit manifest codes are assigned and source names are reconciliation-only.

GoalTierWeight, VolumeBudgetRow, ExerciseMuscleContribution, SlotTemplate, and WeekTemplate IDs are assigned from declaration order in the current source; this manifest gives them immutable assigned codes and semantic reconciliation keys.

Exact starter catalog codes can carry runtime collision suffixes when existing rows already occupy the generated code. The manifest captures source-derived base codes and every ENGINE_ overwrite; the existing user database inventory is not supplied here.
remainingIssues: Draft requires independent confirmation of row coverage, uniqueness and source reconciliation keys.
SQLite seed paths use name matching, table emptiness or repair behavior; PostgreSQL implementation must upsert by seedCode and preserve owner edits.

Starter Exercise legacy codes are generated from source display names by the current SQLite seed helper; each code is recorded literally here for compatibility, and future PG seed identity must use the immutable seedCode. Existing database collision suffixes are not represented because they depend on installed rows.
